json_schema.description: The poke cap was reached: this goal is quarantined and will never be poked again. DELIBERATELY NOT a contract in M1b (opens=false), which is a deviation from the plan's 'escalation + quarantine' reading and is recorded on QUM-1250 as an approved decision — M1b ships no closer for it, because the user inbox that would resolve an escalation is M3, so opening a contract here would leave every stuck goal permanently outstanding and force the sweeper to special-case its own output. Quarantine is expressed instead as 'a goal with a goal_stuck event is never poked again', which is what actually stops the token burn. NOT spillable: a quarantine marker recorded only locally would let another host keep poking.
